query:
SELECT hs.id, hs.rfqId, hs.chain, hs.status, hs.htlcAddress, hs.locktime,
       FROM_UNIXTIME(hs.locktime) as locktime_human,
       CASE WHEN hs.locktime < UNIX_TIMESTAMP() THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE CONCAT('active, expires in ', ROUND((hs.locktime - UNIX_TIMESTAMP())/60), ' min') END as timelock_state,
       sa.status as analytics_status, sa.settlementTime, sa.settledVia, sa.solClaimTx, sa.createdAt as trade_created
FROM htlc_swaps hs
LEFT JOIN swap_analytics sa ON sa.rfqId = hs.rfqId
WHERE hs.status = 'pending' AND hs.chain = 'solana'
ORDER BY hs.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 5;
